prompts.name: start
prompts.description: Orient and start working in this project.
prompts.body:
You are working in **squawk-ui** (`generic`, `typescript`).

First call `squawk_overview` — it is the canonical map of this server's tools, plugins and a `recommendedNextAction`. Follow the recommendation.

## Project shape

- Type: `generic`
- Framework: `svelte`
- Monorepo tool: _(none)_
- Test runner: `unknown`
- Package manager: `bun`

## Quality gates

- `build` → `bun ui/build.ts`

## When you change the project

1. Re-run `squawk_analyze_project` to refresh the analysis.
2. If the project grew (new scripts, new framework deps, new monorepo packages), call `squawk_plan_mcp_project` to refresh the blueprint and `squawk_create_project` to materialise the new tools.
3. Never invent tool names; only call what `overview` lists.

prompts.name: fix quality
prompts.description: Run the gates and fix what fails.
prompts.body:
Run the project quality gates in this order and fix what fails:
1. `build` → `bun ui/build.ts`

If a gate is broken because of an external dep (downstream service, network, missing env), record it as `external-gate-blocker` with the evidence and continue.

## Language conventions

- `strict: true` in tsconfig — no implicit any.
- Prefer `readonly` and discriminated unions over enums.

## svelte conventions
